wants: A scroll wheel or rotary encoder, plus a second button. The enclosure should look like real jewellery — a gold pendant, not a gadget.
implication_for_output: A visible multi-colour status LED fights the aesthetic. Haptics do not, and the parts are already owned. Prefer haptic patterns over light for status.
implication_for_input: Roughly twenty distinct meanings were proposed across this committee for "long press", because there is a way to TRIGGER and no way to SELECT among options. A rotary encoder supplies that missing axis — a timer to scrub, a list to page. Proposals wanting a new gesture on an existing button should be re-examined against a wheel.
firmware_constraint_that_still_holds: main.c:29-38 records that button 1 acts on the ACTIVE EDGE so the microphone powers up before the finger lifts. Any gesture on sw0 means waiting several hundred ms on every press to find out which gesture it was. sw0 carries no gestures by design.
